_what: How a file chip (FileChip.tsx) and any file tile draw one file's kind and its folder, as DATA. `families` maps the start of a file's media type to the named icon its kind shows (parts/ui/show/icon NamedIcon); `endings` names the family of a file with no media type by the ending of its name; `fallback` is the icon of any other file. `folder_colours` are the screen-look palette hues (parts/screen-look/show/coss-workspace.css `--record-kind-<id>`, the ids of src/space-settings.json colours) a folder's badge is drawn in: each folder always gets the same one, picked by its name. Red is left out, since red is kept for notifications. A new kind of file is one row here.
